description: Creates or updates one named site profile for this account. Fields omitted from `field` keep their current saved value (or blank, if the profile is new); pass only what changed. custom_field entries are merged key-by-key. An account may keep more than one named profile (e.g. one per brand/site).

field.description: Fields to change. Omitted fields keep their current value.

siteprofilename.description: Name for this profile, e.g. "default" or "acme-co".

name: set_siteprofile
title: Set site profile
